# Kindling α4.1c: Learning responds to experience

## What is new

People value tools through their own known uses and include travel/work time in teaching and tending choices. Personal seven-day experience adjusts exploration and helping within fixed bounds; History shows the recorded pressure and gain. Fire trial feedback has its own saved identity.

Resumed lessons meet at the teacher's actual place, and unfinished observation progress reopens correctly. Fires keep separate selectable markers, including overlapping sources. This is save format 11; older camps are refused plainly.

## What to try

Start a camp, inspect a person's three reasons and learning experience in History, then reopen. Touch overlapping fires repeatedly to cycle their identities. Try large text and rotation.

## What is rough

Acceptance fails: spread 12/20; ordinary cold-camp fire chain 0/16, with three friction attempts and one ember. P1 reaches 4.57 years/minute, below 5 and the eventual desktop target of 20. The coordinator skipped repeat batches under owner guidance; the owner can overrule. No combined-40 result is claimed. A score-only teaching change is approved for subsequent work; these verdicts stand.

One intermittent Worlds reopening error did not reproduce and remains for independent review.
